name: Gummy Stem Blight of Cucumber
description: A fungal disease causing stem cankers, leaf spots, and fruit rot in cucumber. It produces a characteristic gummy exudate on infected stems and is particularly damaging in warm, humid conditions.
symptoms: Water-soaked stem lesions near soil line turning tan to brown
Amber-colored gummy exudate on stems and fruit
Circular brown leaf spots with concentric rings
Fruit rot with dark, sunken lesions
Black fruiting bodies (pycnidia) visible on infected tissue
causes: Crop debris harboring fungus between seasons
treatments: Apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil or mancozeb
Remove and destroy infected plant parts
Apply copper-based fungicides as preventive treatment
prevention: Use drip irrigation to keep foliage dry
Space plants adequately for air circulation
